title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
ii.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
iii.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
iv.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
v.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
colophon: rain that mostly forgets, and a few drops it decides to hold.
